referenceImages.purpose: Sunlit anime illustration, candid close composition, lighting and everyday atmosphere

commonPrompt:
Create ONE finished 16:9 widescreen character-driven game background illustration for TownGrid, suitable for a title/home/loading screen, not a collage or sprite sheet. High-resolution full-bleed landscape.
You have FOUR reference images in order: (1) the user's sunlit anime office scene; (2) existing TownGrid character MIRA, brown high-ponytail mechanic; (3) existing TownGrid character MARNA, copper-red braided dwarf craftswoman; (4) existing TownGrid character SILEN, mint-haired elf engineer/mage.
Reference 1 controls VISUAL STYLE and CINEMATIC INTIMACY ONLY: accomplished anime illustration, confident fine linework, soft painterly shading, luminous daylight through windows and blinds, warm reflected sunlight, tactile everyday work objects, natural lived-in room, candid close/medium camera, engaging composition with foreground depth. Do not copy that woman's identity, black suit, red heels, feet-on-desk pose, or face covered by a book. Each subject is visibly working and face is visible.
References 2-4 are EXISTING CHARACTER IDENTITIES. Preserve the selected person's face design, eye color, hair color and hairdo, species, silhouette, distinctive outfit and accessories very faithfully, translating the reference's pixel edges into the smooth detailed anime rendering of reference 1. No pixel filter or chibi redesign, no generic replacement woman. All depicted workers are adults.
TownGrid setting: a lived-in fantasy-and-modern-industry town: sawmill/timber, tools, crop processing, rail freight, delivery trucks, magical crystal energy supplementing physical machinery. This is a believable profession scene and character moment, not combat or a fashion pinup. Make what the person is doing instantly legible through the contact between their tool, hands and the workpiece; anatomically coherent hands and sound mechanical perspective. Do not substitute for work by having them merely hold a tool at camera.
Create an emotionally appealing inhabited working environment, with a specific story and little signs of repeated daily use. Strong readable focal character at medium/close distance, occupying 45-60% of the picture, near eye-level cinematic perspective, not overhead isometric village view. The scene extends naturally across the whole image, with an uncluttered lower strip suitable for an eventual UI overlay. Warm ivory, teal/green shadows, copper and amber accents, coherent series palette.
No text, no typography, no captions, no menus, no progress bars, no watermark, no logo. This is a finished background illustration concept to which the approved logo and real UI can later be added.

images.label: 미라 · 정비소
images.prompt:
SUBJECT: MIRA, reference 2 only for the main character identity. Adult human woman, bright amber eyes, warm medium-brown voluminous high ponytail secured with dark teal tie, gold small earrings, cropped teal mechanic jacket with brass trims and emblem, cream ribbed high-neck top, dark practical shorts, brown fingerless work gloves, leather tool belt and pouches. Keep this costume recognizable with no new revealing redesign.
SCENE: A sunny riverside repair garage. Mira is on the right-center, three-quarter profile, slightly leaning forward from a low mechanic's stool to tighten a visible bolt with a silver wrench on the open side of a small teal delivery truck's engine. Her right hand turns the wrench at the bolt, her left steadies the metal engine housing. Her face is plainly visible, focused but content, a loose curl backlit beside her cheek. Depict credible wrench contact, normal fingers, engine bolts and tidy hoses. Portrait is from approximately knees-up with the truck's open engine bay entering from lower left, friendly close camera, dynamic diagonal composition with an oil rag and spare gear in foreground. Warm afternoon beams through tall workshop windows illuminate floating dust and her brown hair. Mug and handwritten-but-illegible maintenance sheets on a side bench, hanging tools, brass gauges; beyond the wide open garage door, a glimpse of the town's stone road, timber stacks and river. Make it feel like an observed afternoon at work, not someone posing for a character card. A tiny distant worker moving a crate may provide atmosphere but no additional main character.

images.label: 마르나 · 공방
images.prompt:
SUBJECT: MARNA, reference 3 only for the main character identity. Adult dwarf craftswoman, compact sturdy adult proportions, copper-red thick braid draped over her shoulder, amber eyes, brass round goggles resting on top of her head, charcoal rolled-sleeve work shirt, mustard ochre leather tool apron with brass buckles, dark blue trousers, brown gloves, tools and gear accessories at her waist. Preserve her kind confident recognizable face and shorter adult build; do not depict a child or caricature.
SCENE: Inside a warm active precision-machine workshop, Marna stands at a properly lowered broad wooden workbench. She is assembling the exposed brass gearbox of a compact grain-mill motor: left gloved hand secures the solid metal housing, right hand carefully turns a screwdriver against a real screw on the casing. Several meshing large gears and a small secured cyan crystal cell are visible; no impossible floating components. Camera is close, chest-height, three-quarter view, showing her face at upper right and her substantial working hands and machine prominently at the lower center, foreground brass parts tray, calipers and a blue assembly drawing with no legible text. Slanted sunlight from a large left window strikes her red braid, freckles, warm goggles and apron. She has an easy confident half-smile while inspecting alignment, eyes on her work. Background includes a sturdy drill press, hanging spanners, shelving with timber and machine housings, and a view toward a grain mill and rail siding through the window. Rich tactile iron, wood and brass; serene, industrious, everyday slice-of-life anime scene. The beauty comes from light, character and craft, not excessive magical effects.

images.label: 실렌 · 마력 온실
images.prompt:
SUBJECT: SILEN, reference 4 only for the main character identity. Adult elf woman, very long pale mint-sage hair with braided crown, long pointed elf ears, green eyes, ornate brass-and-green-gem hair clasp and matching earrings, deep sage short cape/jacket, ivory high-neck blouse, dark brown waist corset and utility belts with brass buckles, ivory trousers, brown thigh straps and side pouch with green crystal. Keep her unique facial features, mature adult proportions and exact mint/green/ivory character palette.
SCENE: A working greenhouse and magical irrigation workshop at the edge of the town. Silen is leaning slightly over a waist-height brass-and-glass irrigation control assembly among lush crops; one hand turns a brass flow-control wheel, the other checks a firmly installed emerald crystal regulator with a delicate diagnostic touch, producing just a faint green glow. Her recognizable short brass staff from reference is leaned securely against the workbench, not held as a weapon. Eyes focused on a clear vertical water gauge, calm thoughtful expression. Water visibly travels through a transparent inspection tube toward irrigation pipes feeding crop trays, showing practical production engineering, not a fantasy forest portrait. Character placed center-right in close three-quarter profile, from hips up, long hair tied loosely behind her work area while her braided crown, hair ornament and main silhouette remain recognizable. Strong golden morning sun streams through greenhouse glazing and leaf shadows pattern the floor and desk. Gentle sunlit leaves, useful tools, seedling trays and folded maintenance notebook in foreground. Through a large opening in the left background, the settlement's teal-roof workshops, delivery cart and a distant rail bridge make it part of an industrial town. Rich natural scene with clear hands, no floating tools, no giant spell circles. A quiet, capable worker caring for the town's production system.
